title: Northstar synthetic plan: physical therapy authorization
source: CC0 synthetic training fixture; fictional policy statement
text: TRAINING FIXTURE — FICTIONAL POLICY. The Northstar sample plan allows six in-network physical therapy visits for a new treatment episode without prior authorization. The treating in-network clinician must request authorization before visit seven. An approved request may cover up to eight additional visits during the same episode. The member must confirm that the provider is in network and that the episode is recorded under the correct plan year. A referral is not the same thing as prior authorization. The synthetic plan text does not specify appeal deadlines for an authorization denial, coverage for out-of-network therapy, occupational therapy, or post-surgical exceptions. The assistant must not claim that a referral guarantees payment. It should cite this document for the six-visit and authorization rules and identify unanswered questions separately. This training record is fictional and does not change any real treatment decision, claim, coverage, or member account.
